brand.name: Suvi Interior

brand.emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY & ARCHITECTURAL PRECISION (Warm Editorial Minimalism)
aesthetic_fusion: Milanese high-end residential atelier (slotted joinery, rich oxblood lacquer, warm stone)
Swiss editorial publication layout (asymmetric typography, tight tracking, deep grid tension)
Tactile craftsmanship & materiality (walnut veneer, aged brass, raw limestone, fine linen)

critical_fixes_and_user_mandates: GLOBAL APPLICATION OF BRAND PRIMARY #58130e: The signature oxblood (#58130e) was previously isolated or barely felt. It MUST now permeate all pages systematically: header badges, category filter active states, hover borders, interactive pills, page hero accents, CTA backgrounds, quotation rules, timeline markers, and card accents.

NO BLANK PAGES / NO GATED ANIMATION DEPENDENCIES: Technical flaw was opacity: 0 AnimatePresence route wrappers and delayed entrance triggers blocking renders. All pages must render content immediately with default opacity: 1 and pure CSS or non-blocking motion.
DIRECT PDF BROCHURE DOWNLOAD: Zero form gates. Clicking 'Download PDF' anywhere on the site or /brochure page triggers immediate direct browser download of the 7-page studio document.

DISTINCT INNER PAGE PERSONAS & LAYOUT REVOLUTION: The user noted 'I liked the hero section of the homepage a little bit but from there I do not like anything'. Homepage below hero and inner pages (/projects, /services, /about, /process, /gallery, /contact, /brochure) must break away from generic stacked cards into varied asymmetric editorial layouts: magazine spreads, horizontal project registries, modular specification sheets, and architectural atelier dossiers.
PRESERVE FACTUAL TRUTH: Never invent fake awards, client names, or statistics. All imagery labeled truthfully as 'Representative studio craft archive' until Nashik workshop capture is uploaded.

technical_and_animation_protocol.zero_blocking_motion: All page content MUST have initial opacity: 1 in CSS or fast non-blocking enter transitions (max 0.4s). Do not hide pages behind unmounted AnimatePresence gates.
technical_and_animation_protocol.smooth_scrolling: Lenis smooth scroll integration preserved and tuned with wheel multiplier 1.0 for luxurious weighted inertia.
technical_and_animation_protocol.test_ids: Every key element MUST retain or include role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., `data-testid="header-cta"`, `data-testid="brochure-download-btn-bar"`, `data-testid="project-filter-all"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace or remove fragile full-page route-gate animations in App.js / PageWrap.jsx that led to blank screens on /projects and /brochure.
2. Globally inject brand primary #58130e into tailwind tokens and apply it across every view: headers, buttons, labels, active tabs, timeline badges, and CTA cards.
3. Keep the homepage hero section since user liked it, but completely transform everything below the hero using the multi-section magazine layout specified above.
4. Overhaul all inner pages (/projects, /services, /about, /process, /gallery, /contact, /brochure) so each has a distinctive, high-end editorial identity.
5. Ensure the PDF brochure download is 100% direct and ungated on click of any DownloadButton component.
6. Verify all test-id attributes remain intact for end-to-end regression tests.
